senses.gloss:
फण् फण्, cl. 1. P. फणति, पफाण
(2nd sing. फेणिथ or पफणिथ,
3rd pl. फेणुस् or पफणुस्), फणिष्यति,
अफणीत्, अफाणीत्, फणितुम्, to go, go about,
move: Caus. फणयति, फाणयति, -यितुम्, to
cause to spring or run (Ved.); फाणयति, to scum,
skim, take off (the surface of a fluid); to produce
easily or without exertion: Desid. पिफणिषति:
Intens. पम्फण्यते, पम्फणीति, पम्फण्टि.

फण, अस्, m. (perhaps) scum, froth (Ved.);
(अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n. the expanded side of a nostril;
(अस्, आ), m. f. the expanded hood or neck of the
cobra di capello (= फट); अङ्गुली-फण-हस्तक,
one in whose hands the fingers take the shape of a
hood; [cf. गो-फणा.]
—फण-कर, अस्, m. the
cobra di capello, Coluber Naga; a snake in general.
—फण-गिरि, see फेन-गिरि.
—फण-त्रय,
अम्, n. three hoods (of a snake).
—फण-धर,
अस्, m. = फण-कर; an epithet of Śiva.
—फण-
भृत्, त्, m. = फण-कर; a symbolical expression
for the number nine (or eight).
—फण-मणि,
इस्, m. ‘hood-gem,’ a jewel supposed to be found in
the hood of a snake.
—फण-मण्डल, अम्, n.
[]
‘hood-orb,’ the rounded hood (of a serpent).
—फ-
ण-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a hood, hooded; (आन्),
m. the cobra di capello, a snake in general.
—फ-
ण-श्रेणी, f. a line or row of serpents’ hoods.
—फण-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, being in a serpent's hood
(as a gem).
—फणा-कर, अस्, m. = फण-कर.
—फणाटोप (˚ण-आट्˚ or ˚णा-आट्˚), अस्, m. the
swelling of a serpent's hood.
—फणाटोपिन्, ई, इनी,
इ, having the hood swollen (said of a serpent).
—फणातपत्र (˚ण-आत्˚ or ˚णा-आत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
having a hood for a parasol (said of a serpent).
—फणा-धर, अस्, m. = फण-धर.
—फ-
णा-फलक, अम्, n. the flat surface of a serpent's
hood.
—फणा-भर, अस्, m. the cobra di capello.
—फणा-भृत्, त्, m. ‘hood-bearing,’ a snake,
serpent.
—फणा-मणि-सहस्र-रुच्, f. the splendor
of the thousand jewels on the hood (of the serpent-
king, Māgha IX. 25).
—फणा-वत्, आन्, m. ‘pos-
sessing a hood,’ the cobra di capello, a snake.

फणिका, f. the tree Ficus Oppositifolia.
—फ-
णिकेश्वर (˚का-ईश्˚), अस्, m., N. of one of the eight
Vīta-rāgas of the Buddhists; [cf. फणीन्द्रेश्वर.]

फणिकार, अस्, m. an epithet of Piṅgala, (perhaps
incorrectly for फण-कर or फणा-कर, which
would be analogous to his epithets नाग-राज and
भुजङ्गेश); N. of a people, (also read कर्णिकार.)
फणित, अस्, आ, अम्, gone; diluted (?).

फाणित, अम्, n. (fr. Caus. of rt. फण्), the in-
spissated juice of the sugar-cane, raw sugar; the
inspissated juice of other plants; [cf. Arab. فانيذ
Pers. پانيد medieval Lat. penidium.]
—फा-
णिती-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, inspissated.

फणिन्, ई, m. the hooded serpent, cobra di
capello, a serpent in general; an epithet of Rāhu;
of Patañjali; a species of herb (= सर्पिणी).
—फ-
णि-कन्या, f. the daughter of a serpent-demon.
—फणि-केशर or फणि-केसर, अस्, अम्, m. n.
Mesua Roxburghii (= नाग-केसर).
—फणि-जा,
f. a species of plant (= Marāṭhī झरसी).
—फणि-
जिह्वा, f. ‘serpent's tongue,’ N. of a plant (= महा-
शतावरी); the plant Sida Cordifolia (= महा-स-
मङ्गा).
—फणि-जिह्विका, f. the plant Emblica
Officinalis; = फणि-जिह्वा.
—फणि-तल्प-ग, अस्,
m. ‘resorting to a serpent as a couch,’ an epithet
of Viṣṇu.
—फणि-पति, इस्, m. ‘serpent-king,’ N.
of the serpent Śeṣa; of Patañjali.
—फणि-प्रिय,
अस्, m. ‘serpent's friend,’ wind.
—फणि-फेण, अस्,
m. ‘snake's saliva,’ opium (= अहि-फेण).
—फणि-
भारिका, f. the tree Ficus Oppositifolia (= फ-
णिका).
—फणि-भाष्य, अम्, n. the commentary
of Patañjali (= महा-भाष्य).
—फणि-भुज्, क्,
m. ‘serpent-eater,’ a peacock.
—फणि-मुख,
अम्, n. ‘serpent's mouth,’ a kind of spade used by
housebreakers.
—फणि-लता or फणि-वल्ली, f. betel-
pepper (= नाग-वल्ली).
—फणि-हन्त्री, f. the plant
with which the ichneumon is said to cure itself after
the bite of a snake (= गन्ध-नाकुली).
—फणि-
हृत्, त्, f. a kind of plant (= क्षुद्रा दुर्-आलभा).
—फणीन्द्र (˚णि-इन्˚), अस्, m. ‘serpent-chief,’ an
epithet of the serpent-demon Śeṣa; an epithet of
Patañjali (= फणिन्).
—फणीन्द्रेश्वर(˚र-ईश्˚),
अस्, m., N. of one of the eight Vīta-rāgas of the
Buddhists; [cf. फणिकेश्वर.]
—फणीश (˚णि-
ईश), अस्, m. ‘serpent-chief,’ an epithet of Patañjali
(= फणिन्).
—फणीश्वर (˚णि-ईश्˚), अस्, m. ‘ser-
pent-chief,’ an epithet of the serpent-demon Śeṣa;
an epithet of Patañjali (= फणिन्).

फणीय, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), Cerasus Puddum
(= पद्म-काष्ठ).
फण्ड, अस्, m. the belly (= फाण्ड).
फाण्ड, अम्, n. the belly (= फण्ड).

फणिखेल फणिखेल, अस्, m. a quail; (pro-
bably incorrectly for फाल-खेला.)

फणिज्झक फणिज्झक, अस्, m. marjoram
and another similar plant; (आ), f. a plant, apparently
a species of basil with small leaves (commonly called
राम-दूति).
फणी फणी, f., N. of a river.

फाणि फाणि, इस्, f. (fr. rt. फण्), unrefined
sugar, molasses; flour or meal mixed with curds (=
करम्भ).

फाण्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (a contraction of फाणित),
obtained by straining or filtering, readily or easily
prepared, anything made by an easy process (as a
decoction &c.); (अस्), m. an infusion, decoction,
pounded medicinal substances mixed with four parts
of hot water and filtered; (अम्), n. the first particles
of butter that are produced by churning.
—फाण्टा-
हृत (˚ट-आह्˚), अस्, m., N. of a man; a patronymic
from Phāṇṭāhṛti; (आस्), m. pl. the pupils of Phāṇ-
ṭāhṛti.
—फाण्टाहृतायन, अस्, m. a patronymic
from Phāṇṭāhṛti.
—फाण्टाहृति, इस्, m., N. of a
man; see Pāṇ. IV. 1, 150.

फाण्टक, अस्, m. an infusion, decoction (=
फाण्ट).
फाण्डिन्, ई, m., N. of a serpent-demon.
